# Freshservice App for HP Warranty ## A serverless app for faciliating bulk warranty update (for items) for HP and Dell. ### **Features:** - Installer fetches the following details - Freshservice API Key (to fetch/update items, product details) - HP API Key and Secret (to fetch HP Warranty details) - Dell API credentials is common to all accounts and has been provided to the SI team - New fetch frequency - New fetch means fetching and updating new items' warranty details - **For the first "New fetch" job, all items are new** - As soon as app is installed, a "New fetch" job is scheduled within next 24 hours - Another "New fetch" job is scheduled after the "New fetch frequency" days - Refresh frequency - **Refresh jobs updates all jobs** - On app installation, a refresh job is scheduled after the *refreshFrequency* days - Once the job is completed, refresh job is rescheduled after the *refreshFrequency* days - If a job fails, the same job is rescheduled for the next day - On app installation, `onAppInstall` takes care of sending the installation credentials to middleware - Since there's no `onAppUpdate` event, a recurring job takes c
